brief.t: FIRST — send ELOIRE's written commercial answer today: Diana confirmed Aug 1 she expects the 500- and 1,000-unit quote, lead time, and scratch/spotting correction plan today as agreed. No further soft promise.
SECOND — walk Rehman Ghani Arain's booked 10:00 AM ET call with verified 500-unit-per-SKU pricing for his 3-SKU UAE tallow balm line; no guessed numbers on the call.
THIRD — walk Jarrod Adams / Shay Brands' booked 2:00 PM ET call with verified 500/1,000/1,500-unit tiered pricing for the whipped tallow moisturizer line.

FOURTH — unblock Victor Armendarez's 4,000-unit two-SKU quote: pricing was owed "this week" per Friday's briefing; get R&D's written packaging-compatibility confirmation and complete costs before sending either price.

FIFTH — Terra Lotus's 22,000-unit quote and contract remains the carried-forward overdue item from the prior baseline; no new email or CRM evidence surfaced this run, so verify current status directly with Aidan and Ronald before promising a date.
SIXTH — get Atlas's pro forma ready before Tuesday Aug 4, 2:00 PM ET production meeting (Ryne Bell has accepted): still needs fill size/packaging, billing address, and lead time/Incoterms.
SEVENTH — reconcile today's Gusto payroll ACH debits ($10,233.75 and $3,952.15 per Huntington alerts) against the payroll ledger; do not act on any payment from an email link.

kb.a: Diana confirmed Aug 1 she is waiting for the written 500- and 1,000-unit quote, lead time, and scratch/spotting correction plan "as agreed" for Monday, August 3. This is now due today. Send a verified commercial answer, or tell her directly PLL cannot support the reorder — no further "shortly" promise.

Rehman Ghani Arain's call is confirmed for today, Monday August 3 at 10:00 AM ET (6:00 PM UAE), Google Meet invite sent. He wants a 3-SKU private-label tallow balm line (existing base, honey infused, citrus infused) starting at 500 units per SKU, budget-conscious. Walk the call with validated 500-unit pricing and a sample path; no unsupported numbers.

Jarrod Adams of Shay Brands rescheduled his call to today, Monday August 3 at 2:00 PM ET (11:00 AM PT), same Google Meet link. He wants a custom whipped tallow moisturizer hero plus scrub and night cream (phase 2: shampoo/conditioner/body wash), ~1,000 units soft launch, comparing 500/1,000/1,500-unit tiers. He was reminded to send logo/concept files to Laura.

Victor Armendarez's 2,000-units-per-SKU Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel quote remains outstanding; Friday's briefing (Jul 31) shows pricing still owed "this week" and last contact was Jul 21. Edge Gel is a confirmed hot pour with a ~$2.90/unit target, but full costing and R&D's written packaging-compatibility confirmation are not yet verified in current evidence. Do not price or commit until both are in hand.

Terra Lotus's verified 22,000-unit scope, BOM/formula inputs, and operating-cost inputs were the carried-forward top overdue item from the prior baseline (originally due Jul 30). No new Terra Lotus email or CRM evidence surfaced in this morning's Outlook/Gmail/calendar pull — status could not be independently re-verified this run. Confirm current state directly with Aidan and Ronald before any quote or contract action.

Atlas's Tuesday, August 4, 2:00 PM ET production/pro-forma meeting is confirmed — Ryne Bell (atlasskin31@gmail.com) accepted the calendar invite. Per the prior baseline, the pro forma still needs fill size/packaging, billing address, and lead time/Incoterms filled in before the meeting; Sam, Ryne Bell, and Kenna Whitnell are included.

Huntington bank alerts today (Aug 3) show two ACH withdrawals at Gusto: $10,233.75 (Gusto NE) and $3,952.15 (Gusto Tax), totaling roughly $14,185.90. Match this against the payroll ledger for the current pay period; the prior $1,260 Zelle payment and HP Forklifts invoice still need authorization and ledger linkage from the prior baseline. Do not pay from an emailed link.

Vladimir Elgort followed up Aug 3 proposing call times: tomorrow (Tue Aug 4) 9:30–11:30 AM, 1–1:45 PM, or 4–5 PM, or alternate Tuesday slots, all ET, to discuss his EDDS-vs-EDTA chelating shampoo line. No call is booked yet — confirm a time. Technical feasibility, minimums, and documentation scope remain unverified from the prior baseline.

New/growing lead: Philip DiGristina of SEAL Team Slicks says he has roughly $250k to spend across multiple grooming SKUs (pomade, sea salt spray, aftershave, beard oil/balm, body wash) and wants a call plus NDA. Nikkie is handling intake and has already quoted $2,000–$6,000 R&D per custom SKU; beard oil/balm/body wash can go private-label without R&D. Worth Sam's attention given the stated budget size, though still an early-stage inbound qualification, not yet a booked call.

PLL operates at 24600 N. Industrial Dr., Farmington Hills, MI 48335. DTE's start-service order completed Aug 1 (confirmed by DTE email) and the old address's stop-service order was in progress. UPS, USPS, and Shopify address changes and a test workflow remain pending per the prior baseline — no new evidence this run that those were completed.

Ads intelligence and Ads agent brief are preserved unchanged from the last verified nightly Ads refresh (2026-08-02T21:04:32-04:00): three of the last seven days breached the $30/day approved cap (Jul 28 $38.40, Jul 30 $34.87, Aug 1 $40.82), and the morning safety check this cycle was blocked by a Google Ads API quota exhaustion. No Ads settings were changed; only an Ads intelligence job may update these figures.

Live CRM was not re-verified in this morning's refresh — this run did not attempt a CRM login per instructions (no credentials provided). The last verified CRM snapshot (Aug 1) showed $1,327,800 pipeline, 20 active deals, 20 production projects, and $57,454.99 deposits; treat those figures as dated Aug 1, not confirmed current today.

No new authoritative Ashley/Nymphaea payment or supplier-order evidence appeared in this run's Outlook or calendar pulls. The prior request for a 50% Miron glass-container payment remains contingent on a verified supplier amount and order path; keep it off Sam's first lane until that evidence arrives.
